text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Oh, mulberries...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
How nostalgic... to find them here. 
I used to eat them all the time back in 
the mountains.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, this? 
Whenever I discover something, I 
occasionally 
record it like this, alongside a sketch.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's nothing impressive, really... 
Oh, I know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If you'd like, would you care to try it 
too, Tore-san? 
You don't need anything special. It's 
quite fun!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After buying a pocket-sized notebook and 
a pencil at a stationery shop, we set out 
into the hills.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As we walked along chatting... 
my foot stepped on something soft.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Is something the matter!?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... these berries— 
They're the leftovers of a meal.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please look at this nut. 
There are bite marks on it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
The bite marks aren't dirty yet, 
so it must have been eaten very recently. 
It should be somewhere around here...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Rustle, rustle)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
! 
Tore-san, step back.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: (Pop!)

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Look. 
It's a tanuki!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It looks like they were the ones eating 
this nut. 
...Ah, look. 
They've started eating another one over 
there.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
...I feel like 
we've spotted something interesting.
choice_data_list: This is when we should write it down...!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
"A tanuki was eating a fallen nut. 
It noticed us, but paid no mind 
and kept chewing quietly."

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Hehe. That's lovely. 
That's one entry down!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We keep searching carefully around our 
feet for anything else. 
However, we find nothing quite as exciting 
as the tanuki—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Then... 
How about that wood sorrel over there 
this time?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Daring Tact points toward a patch of weed 
with little yellow flowers, 
commonly found clustered by the roadside.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I think you'll definitely want to record 
this. 
...Take a 10-yen coin like this, and...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She rubs a torn leaf against the 10-yen 
coin. 
Right before our eyes, it begins to 
gleam...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's thanks to the oxalic acid found in 
its leaves. 
It has even been used as a remedy for skin 
ailments, you know.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Also, the chameleon plant over there is 
made into tea 
and known as an herbal cure for boils. 
And besides that—

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I continue jotting down the plants Daring 
Tact tells me about. 
On a whim, I pluck a piece of wood sorrel.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...? 
Is something the matter?
choice_data_list:
I thought I'd press it. Want to press one 
too, Daring Tact?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Hehe, what a wonderful idea! 
Yes, let's tuck one into my notebook, too.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And so, observing, listening, 
and recording our discoveries, time passes 
by—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
How did you find it? 
Did you... have fun?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
With Daring Tact's guidance, 
we've put together such a thorough nature 
journal.
choice_data_list:
It's all thanks to you, Daring Tact. 
Truly, thank you.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...If anyone should be thanking someone, 
it's me.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Because there are things in my observation 
log 
that I only got to write down 
thanks to you, Tore-san.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It was because you stepped on that nut 
that we got to see the tanuki eating.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And pressing the wood sorrel flower... 
I don't think I would have ever thought of 
that on my own.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
—We made so many memories today. 
And it's all because you were here with 
me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I look back over my notebook once more. 
With every page turned, the things she 
taught me 
and the scenery of the hills come vividly 
back to mind—
choice_data_list:
A journal made possible because of today—a 
field guide just for today.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...! 
Hehe, you're right!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's an adventure field guide... 
made just for you, Tore-san!
choice_data_list: Co-authored by Daring Tact, of course.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes! 
It's an adventure field guide for the two 
of us!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Um, since we're here, 
would you like to bind it into a proper 
book? 
Together with my observation records from 
today.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
We place both our notes between cardboard 
covers and bind them with string. 
Affixing a label with today's date and a 
title, it becomes—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...The "Hills and Fields Adventure Field 
Guide." 
It's finished!
choice_data_list:
Seeing it finished makes it feel so 
special.
Which one of us keeps it?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Hehe, it's not finished just yet.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Let's keep adding pages to it. 
...Together!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
In that case... could you keep it here? 
That way, we can look through it anytime 
we like.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: And every now and then would be plenty...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
If we could open the guide and talk about 
today... 
I would be so, so happy!

title: Placed Side by Side with the Encyclopedia
